description: This file defines the RemotePlayer class, which manages media playback using remote routes via the RemotePlaybackClient API. It implements playback controls such as play, pause, resume, stop, enqueue, and remove, and handles updates on media session and item statuses, including session management and statistics retrieval.

classes.name: RemotePlayer
classes.description: A class that manages remote media playback, handling session control, media queueing, and status updates.

methods.name: RemotePlayer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the RemotePlayer with context.

methods.name: isRemotePlayback
methods.description: Returns true indicating remote playback.

methods.name: isQueuingSupported
methods.description: Checks if queuing of media items is supported by the remote client.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes connection to a given media route and initializes the RemotePlaybackClient.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases resources associated with the remote playback client.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Starts playing a media item, with a callback on success or error.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specified position within a media item.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Retrieves and updates the status of a media item.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses playback.

methods.name: resume
methods.description: Resumes playback.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops playback and ends session if supported.

methods.name: enqueue
methods.description: Adds a media item to the queue if queuing is supported.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a media item from the queue.

methods.name: updateStatistics
methods.description: Fetches playback statistics from the route.

methods.name: getStatistics
methods.description: Returns the latest playback statistics information.

methods.name: enqueueInternal
methods.description: Handles the internal enqueue process with callbacks.

methods.name: seekInternal
methods.description: Performs internal seek operation.

methods.name: startSession
methods.description: Starts a new playback session.

methods.name: endSession
methods.description: Ends the current playback session.

methods.name: logStatus
methods.description: Logs status updates for debugging.

methods.name: logError
methods.description: Logs errors during operations.

methods.name: throwIfNoSession
methods.description: Checks session validity and throws if invalid.

methods.name: throwIfQueuingUnsupported
methods.description: Checks queuing support and throws if unsupported.
